ideas.idea: Remove noindex from /services or drop it from sitemap (note in report)
ideas.why: This duplicates the known noindex/sitemap problem, but it is accurate; however it is already graded so it is not a new idea.

ideas.idea: Fix missing image: /img/reception.jpg has no src/img and no passthrough copy
ideas.why: Accurate: no img directory exists and .eleventy.js copies only robots.txt and sitemap.xml, so the image would 404.

ideas.idea: Back up 'Trusted by thousands' with a real number, reviews or testimonial
ideas.why: The unsupported claim is on the homepage and evidence would help readers and machines trust it.

ideas.idea: Name the dentists on the team page with role and qualifications, possibly individual pages
ideas.why: The team page has only a vague sentence and no names, so concrete names and qualifications add real content.

ideas.idea: Show prices or link to them on services page
ideas.why: The page claims clear prices but shows none, so this is accurate and specific.

ideas.idea: Describe each service with a paragraph or page
ideas.why: Services is a bare list of four items, so descriptions would answer visitor questions.

ideas.idea: Add address, openingHours and url to the Dentist JSON-LD
ideas.why: The schema has only name and telephone while the address is already on the page.
It is valid but has little effect on a four-page site.

ideas.idea: Add og: tags and WebSite/Organization structured data
ideas.why: Accurate, but it is boilerplate advice with little effect here, and the Dentist data already names the clinic.

ideas.idea: Link the emergency appointments promise to contact details
ideas.why: The homepage mentions emergency care without any route to contact info, so the link is concrete and helpful.
It applies to almost any site and has little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Add Leeds to page titles such as Contact
ideas.why: Minor tweak; the location is already in the description and content, so the effect is small.
